text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: Thank you for waiting—Lady Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
Come this way, then.

Kneel before the grand 'Rose Clan' and its newly blossomed hope.
—'Our Sovereign, Our Rose.'
choice_data_list: I swear to aid in the fulfillment of your noble ambition.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Granted.
Henceforth, thou shalt devote thy loyalty and thy duty unto our realm.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With this, our pact is forged.
Now let us unfurl—the royal banner of the Rose Kingdom's prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...29, ...30.
That concludes the warm-up. What is next on the agenda?
choice_data_list: This is what I have planned. Here you are.

text_block_list.text:
Without delay, I presented the sheet outlining today's training plan.
Her eyes alone traced the words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Pace running followed by uphill training. Time trials on the turf course.
How many uphill reps?
choice_data_list: I will adjust it according to your condition.

text_block_list.text:
I intend to adjust the regimen appropriately according to your condition and fatigue at that time.
...Never shall any excessive burden be placed upon Your person.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Understood. I leave the judgment at each step entirely to you. Now, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For the first set, maintain an even pace with no variations.
The target velocity is—
—Her gait as she heads toward the starting gate feels slightly off.
choice_data_list: Please wait. Pardon me, allow me to attend to your feet.

text_block_list.text:
Kneeling at her feet, I scrutinize every inch of her shoes down to the soles.
With a light movement, she lifts onto her tiptoes, making the undersides easier to inspect.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ............A horseshoe?
choice_data_list: I'll hit it again, so please step over here for a moment, Lord Rose.

text_block_list.text:
Just as expected, her right horseshoe had come slightly loose. While not a severe issue,
I guided her off the track just in case, ensuring the path ahead was safe.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Was it loose? I had not noticed.
You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hello, Rose. You and your Trainer are as ever, I see. One could almost envision a crimson carpet laid out across the woodchips.

While waiting for me to get on with my work, Rose Kingdom
was being spoken to by those who would likely debut alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Just now, when your Trainer knelt before you,
it was truly like a scene from a story where a king and knight exchange vows.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... when did you two sign your Trainer contract?
Before I knew it, you were already by Miss Rose's side...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The contract was formed—the very day he was assigned to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The contract was formed—the very day she was assigned to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that how it was? Normally, contracts are formed
only after assessing one's ability in selection races, or so I have heard—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's almost as if it was prearranged... Ah, no. Come to think of it, I recall seeing it mentioned in some documents before.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Beside Rose-san and the 'Rose Clan' as they galloped through the eras, there were always—trainers whose lifelong duty was to support and devote themselves to that path... or so the story goes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say.
To fulfill the cherished dream of the Rose Clan—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And in order to stand beside that path, he devoted himself
to the necessary discipline, bringing him to where he is today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to walk alongside that path,
she accumulated the necessary discipline, bringing her to where she stands today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Two souls who followed their destinies and forged their own paths, meeting at last in the promised land to walk together toward a shared ambition... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It sounds a bit like an overly idealized master-servant tale, but... it certainly explains why your bond is somewhat different from that of an ordinary Umamusume and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. There is a unique aura between the two of them—one that speaks to a special connection.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Peculiar...? Is that truly so?

Overhearing that exchange, a memory suddenly returned to me.
Of that day when I first laid eyes upon my master――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Come now, everyone. Do you see?
That is the Rose Monarch who carries the future of our house... Lady Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose (Years Ago)
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah...! Fuh...!

Along with the many other 'trainer candidates,' I laid eyes on her.
She possessed an elegance that seemed far beyond her years.

...That being said, it was from a distance, so that was all I could make out.
Even if they told me to 'strive daily in service of Her Grace'—
choice_data_list: (Honestly, it didn't feel very real to me back then.)

text_block_list.text: And yet... since when did it begin?
“To become Rose Kingdom's Trainer.”
To understand its significance—and to finally confront one's own destiny.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have returned—
Oh? Could it be that your work was finished long ago?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. I let our idle chatter go on for too long.
choice_data_list: No. Please treasure your time with your classmates as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm... But for now, let us swiftly resume our training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The grand ambition we seek lies far down the road.
We cannot afford to waste time idling.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must polish myself. I must hone myself to perfection.
All for the sake of the Rose clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The magnificent 'Rose Kingdom'—
to see its realm established, and its eternal flowers bloom.
